---
title: "Database schema"
---

Every command writes to the same DuckDB file. Tables are separated by where their contents
came from, so it stays visible what is Skemman's word and what is the document's.

## From the search listing

### `thesis`

| Column | Source |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Handle suffix from `/handle/1946/<id>` |
| `date_accepted` | First listing column, `DD.MM.YYYY` |
| `title` | Result link text |
| `authors` | Third listing column |

`v_thesis` adds `item_url`, the canonical handle URL.

## From the item page

### `thesis_metadata`

One row per thesis. Titles and abstracts in both languages where present, plus
`degree_level` (normalized to `bachelor`, `master`, `phd`), `thesis_type`, `sponsor`,
`note`, `related_url`, `raw_keywords`, `pdf_url`, and the breadcrumb trail as
`university`, `school`, `study_category`.

### `people`, `thesis_people`

Authors and advisors, deduplicated by name and birth year. The link table carries `role`
(`author` or `advisor`) and source order.

### `keywords`, `thesis_keywords`

Keywords split on semicolons and commas, deduplicated case-insensitively.

### `thesis_file`

One row per attached file, from `files-index`.

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `filename` | As shown on the item page |
| `size_label` | The label, e.g. `86,08 MB` |
| `size_bytes` | Parsed to bytes |
| `access` | `Opinn`, `Lokaður`, or `Lokaður til...<date>` |
| `filetype` | `PDF`, and so on |
| `url` | Absolute bitstream URL |

This table is what plans the download queue.

## From the document

### `thesis_titlepage`

What the title page itself states.

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `faculty`, `school`, `department` | As printed, English pages |
| `deild`, `svid` | As printed, Icelandic pages |
| `ects` | Credits. **Not available anywhere in Skemman's metadata.** |
| `degree` | E.g. `Magister Scientiarum` |
| `subject` | The field named after "degree in" |
| `committee`, `examiner`, `advisors` | Semicolon-separated names |
| `year_on_page` | Year printed on the page |
| `n_pages` | Total pages in the PDF |
| `text_chars` | How much text was extracted |

`n_pages` is the only field that is essentially always present: it comes from the PDF
structure rather than from parsing text.

### `thesis_titlepage_failure`

Why a thesis produced nothing.

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `item_url` | Handle URL, to look it up |
| `pdf_url` | The bitstream that failed |
| `reason` | What went wrong |
| `permanent` | Whether it is worth retrying |

`permanent` files are skipped on later runs unless `--retry-failed` is passed.
